milestone: ATTR22: ignored owning destructor-body values before C receiver release
status: Validated normal ignored destructor-body value cleanup before inner C release; wider lifecycle remains partial.
target: PHP8.5.10 CLI NTS64; pinned local binary/profile
scope: Nonthrowing ignored object/array/static-Closure body return cleanup after entered null-C destructor frames, with normal or stable main exit. Ordinary value/child releases run before the inner receiver decrement. Retained shared values survive until their real later owner retires. Selected-handler owning retval cleanup is separate.

production.rule: Transfer owning RESULT roots into ordinary VALUE release jobs while leaving the same authenticated C_RETURN/DR pair and original CALLS record live; clear RESULT/BASE. Only the empty-root arm decrements the inner receiver. Existing job/array/reference/Closure traversal and GC semantics are reused; no new task, snapshot or source-operation record.

sources: Zend/zend_compile.c:zend_compile_return permits ordinary expression returns when no return type is declared.
Zend/zend_execute_API.c:zend_call_known_function selects a local dummy retval for NULL retval_ptr, then zval_ptr_dtor after zend_call_function returns.
Zend/zend_objects.c:zend_objects_destroy_object adds the inner C protection before the known-instance call and OBJ_RELEASE only after it returns.
Zend/zend_closures.c:zend_closure_free_storage releases captured/static values before its bound receiver.
